verdict.rationale: Penpot's marketing docs confirm CSS Grid and Flex layout support for responsive/rules-based interfaces (penpot-docs-14), but there is no detailed documentation of auto-layout resizing behavior, constraints on resize, or grid systems working the way native UI frameworks flex, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of these specific behaviors. Community evidence instead focuses on general performance/stability issues rather than confirming responsive layout fidelity. missing for 10: detailed docs on constraints-based resizing, auto-layout resize rules, hands-on validation that grids/flex truly mimic real UI responsiveness.
